_comment: Baldor fleet liability policy as printed on the NYS Insurance Identification Card. The card is a FLEET card: the company, NY insurance code, and policy number apply to every unit; only the Year/Make/VIN/Unit # lines change per vehicle. Check that the crash date falls inside the effective window before using it; if not, ask the user for the card in force on the crash date.
insured_name_on_card: HUB TRUCK RENTAL CORPORATION, 155 FOOD CENTER DR, BRONX NY 10474
note: Insured name on the card is the lessor because Baldor issues its policy in the lessor's name for leased units; the registrant block on the MV-104 still comes from the cab card (references/lessor-registry.json), not from this card.
